label: Shelter and habitat world mean by 2030-12-31
prompt: What will the population-weighted world-mean satisfaction score for the shelter and habitat category be on 2030-12-31, computed by the global.10B.categories.shelter rollup? Score is in [0,1] where 1 = full satisfaction across all countries.
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the value of `world_mean` in global/10B/categories/shelter/runs/output.json on 2030-12-31.
